scripts.build: server/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && npm run build --workspace @pact-agent/server && npm run build --workspace @pact-agent/web
scripts.lint: server/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run lint --workspace @pact-agent/server && npm run lint --workspace @pact-agent/web
scripts.dev: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml up -d && npm run dev --workspace @pact-agent/server
